Launch the enriched research application

Source: R/researcher-app.R
tempest_researcher_app.Rd

Opens a dedicated Shiny application for research briefs, optional R analyses and illustrations, and portable reports. Each research or MCP discovery job runs in a separate R process. Cancelling a job or closing its browser session stops its process tree. The existing tempest_app() remains available for interactive Co-STORM sessions.

Usage

tempest_researcher_app(
  ...,
  config = tempest_config(),
  tools = list(),
  mcp_config = NULL,
  output_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "tempest-researcher"),
  model = "openai/gpt-6.1-sol",
  report_library = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

Arguments passed to shiny::runApp().

config

Research configuration from tempest_config(). The model selected in the app applies to all research roles. Custom chat factories and other configuration settings are retained.

tools

Named list of trusted, zero-argument R functions. Each selected function creates a list of ellmer tool definitions inside the research worker. Factories must work in a fresh R process; use explicit package namespaces and do not capture open connections. Tools are attached only to research experts, under Tempest's existing Deputy research permissions.

mcp_config

Optional path to an MCP JSON configuration with a mcpServers object. The app also accepts a session-local JSON upload. Only explicitly selected servers are contacted during discovery, and only selected tools are attached during research. MCP transport and authentication are supplied by Deputy and its supported mcptools versions.

output_dir

Parent directory for newly generated report directories. Existing reports are never overwritten. The default lasts for the current R session; choose a persistent directory to retain reports after R exits.

model

Initial provider/model selection, editable in the application. When omitted with a configured Chat object, starts with that Chat's model. A supplied Chat can change models within its provider; use a custom config chat factory to support switching providers.

report_library

Enable browsing previously published app reports in output_dir. Defaults to FALSE. When enabled, every user of this app can open and download the reports in that directory. Use a dedicated directory managed by the host and enable this only for an audience that can read the entire collection.

Value

Invisibly, the result of shiny::runApp().

Details

Run the application for trusted users. MCP configurations can launch local programs, and host-supplied tool factories execute R code. Discovery does not enable tools. Tool selections do not override Deputy's research permissions: tools requiring filesystem writes, shell execution, or other denied effects remain unavailable. External tool output is research context, not automatically a verified source or claim.

Generated R analysis and image generation are disabled initially and enabled separately for each run. R execution uses the local account's access; it is not an OS sandbox. Image generation uses tempest_image_generator() and reads OPENAI_API_KEY in the worker. Credentials and uploaded MCP configuration contents are not copied into report downloads. Host tools remain responsible for the contents of their own returned data.

A configured Ragnar store is copied into private staging for each research run and opened inside its worker. Existing corpus contents remain available; newly ingested chunks belong to that run and are not written back to the host store. The temporary copy is removed when the job ends. Embedding functions must work in a fresh R process without captured open connections.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
tempest_researcher_app(output_dir = "research-reports", report_library = TRUE)

tempest_researcher_app(
  tools = list(plant_data = function() {
    list(ellmer::tool(
      function() as.data.frame(datasets::CO2),
      name = "read_co2_data",
      description = "Read the built-in CO2 plant experiment data",
      arguments = list(),
      annotations = ellmer::tool_annotations(read_only_hint = TRUE)
    ))
  }),
  mcp_config = "mcp.json"
)
} # }
